recent.quoted_text: @omarisankofa Nice read, Omari. As you point out, the Pistons are having success despite lacking a rim protector. They’re 3 losses are against teams with ultra-talented bigs. Does Duren change those outcomes? He certainly helps, but I wonder if they need to add another big down the stretch.
